rv.q: If Square Go was fantastic, Antigone is one step beyond with the madness of Antigone and Ismene’s situation seen through that teenage prism.
Antigone is a bold and gripping production that looks at the relationship between Antigone and Ismene and it is brought to life with two electric performances.
This sharp, humourous , and deeply tragic production forces us to reconsider the victims of classical heroics, cementing itself as an essential, emotionally staggering revival.
This delicate environment makes the brutality of the sisters’ circumstances all the more striking.
